channel.title: Pescada — News
channel.description: News and press releases about Pescada, tracked document exchange for accounting firms.

item.title: Pescada in six languages, with a daily summary, two-step sign-in and virus scanning
item.description: The app and its emails now speak Spanish, Italian, French, German, Portuguese and English. Accountants get one daily summary instead of an email per document, firms manage their own team, and every upload is checked for viruses.

item.title: Pescada now works in Italy, France, Germany and Portugal
item.description: Accounting firms in five countries can now run their client document exchange on Pescada. Each client follows its own country’s tax IDs, deadlines and e-invoice formats, and national e-invoices and bank files are read exactly, without AI.
